name: Swing memecoin 48-hour breakout retest (4 ATR, 3R, 96h, limit entry)
hypothesis: On hourly bars, 1-12 bars after a close above the prior 48-hour high, buy with a limit 0.1% under the close when the bar dips to within 0.2% of that level and closes above it, above the 200-hour EMA; stop 4 ATR(14), target 3R, exit after 96 bars.

definition.name: Swing memecoin 48-hour breakout retest (4 ATR, 3R, 96h, limit entry)
